en.io: Input is an optional WORK or TASK query plus files such as works/WORK-LIST.md, works/WORK-NN/PROGRESS.md, and TASK-NN_result.md. Output is a concise human-readable status summary.
en.boundary: It only interprets status recorded in the expected files. It does not create work, execute tasks, validate completion claims, or define behavior when records are missing, inconsistent, or use another layout.
dependencies: A project using the documented works/ directory layout
Per-task result files for detailed completion information
scenarios: List all WORK items and their completion counts.
Show progress for a specific WORK.
Read completion details for a particular TASK.
Summarize pipeline status using the documented status values.

zh.io: 输入为可选的 WORK 或 TASK 查询，以及 works/WORK-LIST.md、works/WORK-NN/PROGRESS.md、TASK-NN_result.md 等文件；输出为简洁的人类可读状态摘要。
zh.boundary: 仅解释预期文件中记录的状态，不创建工作、不执行任务，也不验证完成声明；对记录缺失、冲突或采用其他布局的情况未作定义。
dependencies: 采用规定 works/ 目录布局的项目
用于详细完成信息的 TASK 结果文件
scenarios: 列出所有 WORK 及其完成数量。
显示指定 WORK 的进度。
读取特定 TASK 的完成详情。
按照文档中的状态值汇总流水线状态。
